    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.boundaryLinear_changeScalars_surjective_iff {k F : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L] (e : F →ₐ[k] L) {X Y : ScalarCategory k F C} (p : X ⟶ Y) :
    have G := ScalarCategory.changeScalars e; Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear L (G.map p) (G.map p)) ↔ Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear F p p)

    Enlarging the coefficient field preserves rigidity on the scalar-extended terms.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.changeScalars_frobenius_commutes {k F : Type u} [Field k] [Fintype k] [Field F] [Finite F] [Algebra k F] {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {L : Type u} [Field L] [Finite L] [Algebra k L] (e : F →ₐ[k] L) {X Y : ScalarCategory k F C} (p : X ⟶ Y) :
    have σ := FiniteField.frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic k F; have φ := FiniteField.frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic k L; let S := ScalarCategory.changeScalars ↑σ; let G := ScalarCategory.changeScalars e; let T := ScalarCategory.changeScalars ↑φ; G.map (S.map p) = T.map (G.map p)

    Extending coefficients commutes with the Frobenius on each field.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_frobenius_iso_square_of_rigid {k F : Type u} [Field k] [Fintype k] [Field F] [Finite F] [Algebra k F] {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {X Y : ScalarCategory k F C} [Module.Finite k (X.obj ⟶ X.obj)] [Module.Finite k (Y.obj ⟶ Y.obj)] [Module.Finite k (X.obj ⟶ Y.obj)] (p : X ⟶ Y) (hp : Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear F p p)) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (x : Field L) (x_1 : Algebra F L) (x_2 : Algebra k L) (x_3 : IsScalarTower k F L) (x_4 : Finite L), let G := ScalarCategory.changeScalars (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k F L); have φ := FiniteField.frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic k L; let T := ScalarCategory.changeScalars ↑φ; ∃ (a : G.obj X ≅ G.obj X) (b : G.obj Y ≅ G.obj Y), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.hom (G.map p) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (T.map (G.map p)) b.hom

    After a finite extension, a rigid differential on scalar-extended terms is isomorphic to its Frobenius conjugate.
